extName.message: Copystate – Page & Form State to Markdown

extDescription.message: Copy the page you see as Markdown for your AI: text, tables, links and every form field with its value and options. Runs locally.

probeHint.message: Their options are only readable while open. Opens each one briefly on the page and closes it again. Nothing gets selected.

statusNotCopied.message: Copying failed. The text is selected, copy it with your keyboard.

errorRestricted.message: This page can't be read by extensions (browser or store pages).

statusBusy.message: Waiting for an earlier run on this page to finish…

errorBusy.message: Copystate is still finishing an earlier run on this page. Try again in a moment.
